source: Independent source-informed hook, comparison and middleware adapter implementation; no upstream runtime copied. Public declarations and original tests retain MIT attribution. This is not a clean-room claim.

implementation.targetScope: React 19 positioning hook, reactive middleware and DOM exports beneath popover, tooltip and dropdown callers.

changes: Generation-checked asynchronous measurements prevent stale results after newer updates or changed elements/configuration.
Open-state transitions invalidate pending measurements and reopening retained elements positions them again.
Cycle-safe structural middleware comparison preserves opaque object identity and avoids render-phase state updates.

verification.runtime: 15 unchanged upstream runtime tests, ten focused VPM probes, three package groups; Node 24 and Bun. React 19.1.0 and @floating-ui/react 0.27.20 caller.
verification.browser: 72 mounted Chrome app-middleware cases, including every subscription cleanup.
verification.types: Packed TypeScript 7 NodeNext/bundler consumers compile; original type fixture produces the identical single obsolete DOM expectation in both implementations.
verification.limits: Higher-level React interactions remain upstream. No certification of React 16–18, Safari/Firefox or application frame rate.
